notes: API wallet transfer classifier automatically values USDT transactions into USD or USDT wallets without requiring a RUB amount.
Server uses verified transaction asset amount and market USDT/USD rate; stores RUB equivalent only for accounting.
Avoid re-debiting API-connected wallets or double-counting previously classified transfers.
Retain manually entered RUB amounts for other assets and for expense categories.
Automated regression tests for exact USDT 1:1 transfers, variable USD quote and duplicate prevention.
Production release requires passing GitHub tests and user permission (granted in chat).
versionPolicy: Один пакет изменений = один production deploy. Сначала проверка и PR, затем подтверждение пользователя.
